gist.zh: 按航班计划执行飞行，操纵航空器并对飞行安全负最终责任
gist.en: Flies scheduled sectors, commands the aircraft and owns flight safety

gist.zh: 在客舱做安全演示与应急处置，兼顾餐饮和旅客服务
gist.en: Runs cabin safety and emergency duties alongside meal and passenger service

gist.zh: 随机执勤，处置客舱扰序和非法干扰行为
gist.en: Flies as onboard security, handling unruly passengers and unlawful interference

gist.zh: 带飞学员、组织复训与模拟机训练，做技术检查
gist.en: Trains cadets, runs recurrent and simulator sessions, conducts checks

gist.zh: 在机坪做航前航后检查，排除故障并放行航空器
gist.en: Performs pre- and post-flight checks on the ramp, clears faults and releases aircraft

gist.zh: 在机库按工卡做拆装检查与部件更换，完成定检项目
gist.en: Works hangar check cards: disassembly, inspection and part replacement

gist.zh: 做发动机孔探、换发与附件修理，跟踪性能趋势
gist.en: Borescopes, changes engines, repairs accessories and tracks performance trends

gist.zh: 编工卡与维修方案，做故障工程支援和可靠性分析
gist.en: Writes work cards and repair schemes, gives fault support and reliability analysis

gist.zh: 跟适航指令与持续适航文件，管维修记录和局方审定
gist.en: Tracks ADs and continuing-airworthiness data, owns records and authority audits

gist.zh: 管航材采购、库存与周转件送修，保障维修不断料
gist.en: Buys and stocks parts, sends rotables for repair, keeps maintenance supplied

gist.zh: 放行前算航路油量、看天气与航行通告，全程监控航班
gist.en: Plans route and fuel, reads weather and NOTAMs, watches the flight throughout

gist.zh: 配载旅客行李货物，算重心配平并签发载重平衡表
gist.en: Distributes passengers, baggage and freight, computes trim and issues the loadsheet

gist.zh: 在塔台或区域席位指挥航空器起降，保持航路间隔
gist.en: Directs takeoffs, landings and en-route separation from tower or area positions

gist.zh: 盯航班动态、调整航班计划并处置不正常航班
gist.en: Watches flight status, adjusts schedules and handles irregular operations

gist.zh: 办值机行李托运与登机口引导，处理改签和特殊旅客
gist.en: Handles check-in, baggage, boarding gates, rebooking and special passengers

gist.zh: 排地服班组班次，盯航班保障节点与过站时间
gist.en: Rosters ground crews and watches turnaround milestones and times

gist.zh: 接单收货、组板装机与舱位安排，出运单跟单
gist.en: Books and receives freight, builds ULDs, plans capacity and tracks air waybills

gist.zh: 卖舱位给货代和大客户，谈运价并把航班货源填满
gist.en: Sells capacity to forwarders and key accounts, negotiates rates and fills flights

gist.zh: 审危险品申报与包装，按航空运输规则判定能不能收运
gist.en: Reviews DG declarations and packing, rules on acceptance under air transport rules

gist.zh: 运行安全管理体系，做风险评估、事件调查与隐患整改
gist.en: Runs the SMS: risk assessment, event investigation and hazard closure

gist.zh: 按局方规章做内部审核，盯不符合项整改与手册修订
gist.en: Audits against authority regulations, drives findings closure and manual revision

gist.zh: 排飞行与客舱的复训考核计划，管训练记录和资质
gist.en: Plans recurrent training and checks for flight and cabin crew, owns records and ratings

gist.zh: 飞通航作业，做航拍、护林、播撒、医疗转运和带飞
gist.en: Flies GA missions: aerial survey, forest patrol, spraying, medevac and instruction

gist.zh: 安排公务机包机航线、落地许可与机上服务
gist.en: Arranges charter routing, landing permits and onboard service for business jets

gist.zh: 规划无人机航线，执飞巡检测绘作业并维护机队
gist.en: Plans drone missions, flies inspection and survey sorties, maintains the fleet

gist.zh: 船长统管全船安全与营运，大副负责货物积载和甲板部工作
gist.en: The master commands ship safety and operation; the chief mate owns stowage and deck work

gist.zh: 值航行班，管航海图书仪器或消防救生设备，做进出港准备
gist.en: Keeps navigational watch, owns charts or safety gear, prepares port arrivals

gist.zh: 轮机长管机舱全部机械，大管轮负责主机与值班机械维护
gist.en: The chief engineer runs the engine room; the second owns the main engine and watch machinery

gist.zh: 机舱值班，维护主辅机、锅炉与管系，处理机械故障
gist.en: Keeps engine watch, maintains main and auxiliary machinery, boilers and piping

gist.zh: 管船上配电板、自动化与电子设备，处理电气仪表故障
gist.en: Owns switchboards, automation and electronics, fixes electrical and instrument faults

gist.zh: 配员上下船、办证件签证与适任培训，处理船员劳务纠纷
gist.en: Rotates crew, arranges certificates, visas and training, settles labour disputes

gist.zh: 岸基盯船舶航行安全与操作规范，跟港口国检查和缺陷整改
gist.en: Oversees navigation safety and procedures ashore, follows PSC findings to closure

gist.zh: 管船舶机械状态、坞修与备件计划，控制维修预算
gist.en: Manages machinery condition, drydocking and spares, controls repair budgets

gist.zh: 跑安全管理体系内审与事故调查，履行公司指定人员职责
gist.en: Runs ISM audits and casualty investigation, acts as the designated person ashore

gist.zh: 排船舶靠泊顺序与泊位计划，协调装卸机械和人员配置
gist.en: Sequences vessel calls and berths, matches cranes and gangs to the workload

gist.zh: 现场指挥装卸、清点箱货件数并核对单据与残损
gist.en: Directs handling on the wharf, tallies boxes and cargo, checks documents and damage

gist.zh: 排堆场箱位、盯翻倒箱与空箱周转，管进出场闸口
gist.en: Plans yard slots, watches reshuffles and empty turns, runs the gate

gist.zh: 管一个码头的生产效率、成本与安全，对船公司交付作业指标
gist.en: Runs a terminal's productivity, cost and safety, delivers on carrier service levels

gist.zh: 代船东办进出港手续、引航拖轮与物料供应，协调靠离泊
gist.en: Clears the ship in and out, books pilots, tugs and supplies, coordinates berthing

gist.zh: 做报关报检、商品归类与缴税，处理查验和放行
gist.en: Files customs and inspection entries, classifies goods, pays duty, clears holds

gist.zh: 订舱制提单、备报关资料并跟船期，处理改单和放货
gist.en: Books space, issues bills of lading, tracks schedules, amends docs and releases cargo

gist.zh: 找船配货谈运价，做航次估算与租约条款谈判
gist.en: Matches ships and cargo, negotiates rates, runs voyage estimates and charter terms

gist.zh: 登轮引领船舶进出港与靠离泊，在受限水域操纵大船
gist.en: Boards and conns ships in and out of port, handling large vessels in confined waters

gist.zh: 值守交管中心监控通航秩序，查船舶违章并承担搜救值班
gist.en: Mans VTS watching traffic, inspects violations and stands search-and-rescue duty

gist.zh: 做水路运输与港口规划，办水运许可并管港口岸线
gist.en: Plans waterborne transport and ports, issues permits, manages shoreline use

gist.zh: 测航道水深、维护航标助航设施并安排疏浚作业
gist.en: Sounds channel depths, maintains aids to navigation, schedules dredging

gist.zh: 编制井下采掘计划，盯采场支护、出矿与工程质量
gist.en: Plans stoping and development; owns support, ore draw, work quality

gist.zh: 排台阶与剥采计划，管边坡稳定和铲装运输配合
gist.en: Bench and strip plans; slope stability and shovel-truck match

gist.zh: 设计炮孔与装药量，现场组织装药起爆，控振动飞石
gist.en: Designs holes and charges; runs loading and firing; limits vibration

gist.zh: 在设计院出开拓、采矿方法与通风系统的方案和图纸
gist.en: Produces development, mining method and ventilation designs

gist.zh: 跟采掘现场编录，圈定矿体边界，控制采出矿石品位
gist.en: Logs faces, delineates orebody limits, controls mined grade

gist.zh: 野外踏勘填图、布钻取样，写勘查报告推进找矿
gist.en: Field mapping, drill layout, sampling, exploration reporting

gist.zh: 安排钻机开孔与钻进工艺，管岩心采取率和护壁堵漏
gist.en: Rig scheduling and drilling method; core recovery and hole stability

gist.zh: 布测线做电磁法与地震采集，反演解释圈出找矿靶区
gist.en: Runs EM and seismic surveys; inverts and interprets to target

gist.zh: 按网度采土壤岩石样，用元素异常缩小找矿范围
gist.en: Grid soil and rock sampling; narrows targets from element anomalies

name.zh: 水文与工程地质工程师

gist.zh: 查含水层与涌水量，出防治水方案和岩土稳定性评价
gist.en: Aquifer and inflow assessment; water control and ground stability

gist.zh: 定破碎磨矿浮选流程，调药剂制度提回收率与精矿品位
gist.en: Sets the flowsheet and reagent regime; lifts recovery and grade

gist.zh: 调浮选药剂与充气量，做小试和现场标定稳住精矿指标
gist.en: Tunes reagents and aeration; bench tests and plant surveys

gist.zh: 管破碎筛分与磨矿分级，控粒度、处理量和吨矿电耗
gist.en: Crushing, screening, grinding: size, throughput, energy per tonne

gist.zh: 管井下机电设备选型检修，保通风排水提升系统不停机
gist.en: Selects and maintains underground E&M; keeps critical systems up

gist.zh: 管矿井提升机、绞车与胶带输送机的检修与安全保护
gist.en: Maintains hoists, winches and belt conveyors and their interlocks

gist.zh: 做井上下供配电设计与变电所运维，保障防爆和漏电保护
gist.en: Surface and underground power design; substation ops; explosion protection

gist.zh: 排检修计划，处理设备故障，管备件与点检定修
gist.en: Plans shutdowns, fixes breakdowns, owns spares and inspection rounds

gist.zh: 算风量布通风网络，测风调风保证井下风量与风质
gist.en: Sizes airflow and network; measures and balances to keep air quality

gist.zh: 做瓦斯抽采与突出预测，管钻孔与监控系统防超限
gist.en: Gas drainage and outburst prediction; boreholes and monitoring

gist.zh: 查隐患、组织培训与应急演练，对接安监部门检查
gist.en: Hazard inspection, training, drills, regulator liaison

gist.zh: 盯坝体位移与浸润线，管排洪与在线监测，做安全评价
gist.en: Watches dam movement and phreatic line; spillway, monitoring, review

gist.zh: 值班待命，处置火灾透水瓦斯事故，做演练和器材维护
gist.en: On standby for fire, inrush and gas events; drills and gear upkeep

gist.zh: 测井上下控制与采掘工程，出测量图核算采剥量
gist.en: Surveys control nets and workings; issues plans and volume reconciliations

name.zh: 储量与资源评估工程师

gist.zh: 建品位模型估算资源量，做储量核实与技术经济评价
gist.en: Builds grade models, estimates resources, reconciles reserves

gist.zh: 用矿业软件建地质与采矿模型，出配矿与进度计划
gist.en: Builds geological and mine models; blending and schedule outputs

gist.zh: 盯冶炼工艺参数与炉料配比，处理生产异常并降本
gist.en: Owns process parameters and charge mix; fixes upsets, cuts cost

gist.zh: 配炉料算热平衡，调风温布料，稳住高炉顺行和铁水质量
gist.en: Burden and heat balance; blast and charging control; hot metal quality

gist.zh: 定吹炼与合金加入方案，控终点碳温和钢水成分
gist.en: Sets blowing and alloying practice; endpoint carbon, temp, chemistry

gist.zh: 排废钢配料与供电曲线，控冶炼周期和吨钢电耗
gist.en: Scrap mix and power profile; tap-to-tap time and energy per tonne

gist.zh: 用钢包精炼和真空处理调成分，脱氧脱硫控夹杂物
gist.en: Ladle and vacuum treatment: chemistry, deoxidation, inclusions

gist.zh: 定拉速与二冷水表，管结晶器保护渣，控铸坯裂纹偏析
gist.en: Casting speed and cooling; mould flux; cracks and segregation

gist.zh: 排轧制规程与加热制度，控板形、厚度公差和卷取温度
gist.en: Rolling schedule and reheat practice; shape, gauge, coiling temp

gist.zh: 管酸轧、退火与平整工艺，控带钢表面质量和力学性能
gist.en: Pickling, cold mill, annealing, temper: surface and mechanicals

gist.zh: 调镀锌彩涂线的锌层重量与涂层固化，控表面缺陷
gist.en: Zinc coat weight and paint cure on galv and colour lines

gist.zh: 盯熔炼吹炼与阳极炉工序，控铜回收率、渣含铜和杂质
gist.en: Smelting, converting, anode furnace: recovery, slag loss, impurities

gist.zh: 管电解槽工况与阳极更换，控电流效率和吨铝电耗
gist.en: Pot condition and anode change; current efficiency and energy

gist.zh: 设计浸出、萃取与电积流程，控浸出率和溶液杂质
gist.en: Leach, solvent extraction, electrowinning: yield and solution purity

gist.zh: 排铝铜挤压、轧制与拉拔工艺，控型材尺寸和力学性能
gist.en: Extrusion, rolling, drawing of Al and Cu: dimensions and properties

gist.zh: 管配煤、炼焦与化产回收，控焦炭质量和炉温稳定
gist.en: Coal blend, coking, byproduct recovery: coke quality and oven temp

gist.zh: 调配料水分与烧结负压，控烧结矿碱度、强度和成品率
gist.en: Mix moisture and suction; basicity, strength, yield

name.zh: 煤气与余热利用工程师

gist.zh: 做煤气平衡与放散控制，管余热锅炉和自备发电机组
gist.en: Gas balance and flaring control; waste-heat boilers and generation

gist.zh: 定钢种与合金成分体系，做试制验证与客户材料失效分析
gist.en: Sets grades and alloy design; trial production and failure analysis

gist.zh: 编淬火回火与渗碳工艺，控硬度、变形量和金相组织
gist.en: Writes quench, temper and carburize practice; hardness and structure

gist.zh: 选耐蚀材料和涂层，做腐蚀试验与阴极保护设计
gist.en: Selects corrosion-resistant materials and coatings; CP design

gist.zh: 设计浇注系统与砂型工艺，控铸件缩孔、夹渣和尺寸
gist.en: Gating and moulding design; shrinkage, inclusions, dimensions

gist.zh: 定加热与锻造变形工序，设计模具控锻件流线和余量
gist.en: Heating and deformation sequence; die design, grain flow, allowance

gist.zh: 调压铸机压射曲线与模温，控气孔缩松和大件良率
gist.en: Shot profile and die temperature; porosity and yield on large parts

gist.zh: 按炉窑工况配耐材配方，做砌筑方案与炉衬寿命跟踪
gist.en: Formulates refractories to furnace duty; lining design and life

gist.zh: 组织炉窑砌筑与热修，管停炉检修工期和炉衬安全
gist.en: Runs lining installs and hot repairs; outage duration and safety

gist.zh: 管铁合金冶炼与保护渣脱氧剂供应，控成分和使用成本
gist.en: Ferroalloy smelting and supply of fluxes and deoxidizers

gist.zh: 负责燃气场站与管网运行，做技改方案，处置泄漏和抢险
gist.en: Runs stations and network; upgrade plans; leak and emergency response

name.zh: 燃气管网与调压工程师

gist.zh: 管中低压管网与调压站运行，做巡线、置换和压力调整
gist.en: Medium and low pressure network and regulators; patrol, purge, pressure

gist.zh: 做城镇燃气管道与场站设计，出施工图并配合审图
gist.en: Designs urban gas pipelines and stations; drawings and plan review

gist.zh: 排热网水力平衡与运行方案，盯供回水温度和补水量
gist.en: Hydraulic balancing and run plans; supply-return temps and makeup

gist.zh: 管混凝沉淀过滤消毒各段，调加药量保出厂水达标
gist.en: Runs coagulation to disinfection; dosing to meet finished-water specs

name.zh: 污水处理厂运行工程师

gist.zh: 盯生化池溶氧与污泥浓度，调回流排泥，保出水稳定达标
gist.en: Watches DO and MLSS; return and waste sludge; effluent compliance
